# A node a platform has nothing to render with fails the build, on every
# platform, naming what the program wrote, what that resolved to, and where.
#
# html's raw elements are the case that found it: bubbletea and fyne dropped
# the element and its whole subtree in silence, android panicked, and gtk4
# refused but named the bare tag -- `"ul"`, which is neither the spelling at
# the call site nor the declaration it reached.

! sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=bt main.sngl
stderr 'component "html.ul" has no bubbletea implementation'
stderr 'main.sngl:5:9: component'
stderr 'element in sngl:platform/html, reached through its #\[wildcard\]'
! stderr 'panic'

! sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=fy main.sngl
stderr 'component "html.ul" has no fyne implementation'
stderr 'main.sngl:5:9: component'
stderr 'element in sngl:platform/html, reached through its #\[wildcard\]'
! stderr 'panic'

! sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --out=gt main.sngl
stderr 'component "html.ul" has no gtk4 implementation'
stderr 'main.sngl:5:9: component'
stderr 'element in sngl:platform/html, reached through its #\[wildcard\]'
! stderr 'panic'

! sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=an main.sngl
stderr 'component "html.ul" has no android implementation'
stderr 'main.sngl:5:9: component'
stderr 'element in sngl:platform/html, reached through its #\[wildcard\]'
! stderr 'panic'

# html is the platform that declares the element, and renders all of it.
sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=ht main.sngl
grep 'item one' ht/index.html

-- main.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import "sngl:platform/html"

ui.window(title="t") {
    html.ul {
        html.li(textContent="item one")
    }
    ui.text(value="after")
}
